doc.brief: Describes changes in a sorter in more detail and allows users to optimize resorting.
doc.md:
Describes changes in a sorter in more detail and allows users
to optimize resorting.

different.brief: The sorter change cannot be described by any of the other enumeration values
different.md:
The sorter change cannot be described
  by any of the other enumeration values

inverted.md:
The sort order was inverted. Comparisons
  that returned %GTK_ORDERING_SMALLER now return %GTK_ORDERING_LARGER
  and vice versa. Other comparisons return the same values as before.

less_strict.brief: The sorter is less strict: Comparisons may now return %GTK_ORDERING_EQUAL that did not do so before.
less_strict.md:
The sorter is less strict: Comparisons
  may now return %GTK_ORDERING_EQUAL that did not do so before.

more_strict.brief: The sorter is more strict: Comparisons that did return %GTK_ORDERING_EQUAL may not do so anymore.
more_strict.md:
The sorter is more strict: Comparisons
  that did return %GTK_ORDERING_EQUAL may not do so anymore.
